features: Single medium-sized mononuclear cell with high N:C ratio and irregular, angulated cell outline
Nucleus with moderately condensed chromatin; no distinct nucleoli clearly resolved
Scant pale-to-moderately basophilic cytoplasm without granules or Auer rods
Normochromic, normocytic red cells without significant poikilocytosis
Several platelets, including a few large forms, in the background
61659.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows normochromic, normocytic red cells with several platelets, including occasional large forms. A single mononuclear cell with a high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, moderately condensed chromatin, and scant agranular, pale-blue cytoplasm with an irregular outline is present; it most likely represents a lymphocyte, although a circulating immature cell cannot be excluded on a single cell. No specific morphologic features of polycythemia vera are evident in this field; red cell mass and crowding cannot be assessed from a thin-area field. The diagnosis of polycythemia vera requires correlation with hemoglobin/hematocrit, JAK2 mutation status, and bone marrow morphology.

ddx.vs: Reactive lymphocytes are larger with more abundant cytoplasm that hugs adjacent red cells, whereas this cell has scant cytoplasm and a high N:C ratio.
Blasts show finely dispersed chromatin with visible nucleoli, which are not clearly seen in this cell.
Blood morphology cannot separate PV from secondary erythrocytosis; JAK2 V617F/exon 12 mutation and a low serum EPO favor PV.

61595.recognize_zh: 這是多面板組合圖：PET 顯示全身多處淋巴結與器官攝取，流式中腫瘤族群（洋紅色）CD45 呈陰性、表面 CD3 陰性但 CD5 陽性、CD4 陽性並有不等程度 CD8，IHC 顯示 CD3 與 TCL1 陽性，FISH 為 TCL1 重組；即使缺乏表面 CD3/CD45，TCL1 陽性仍指向 T 前淋巴球白血病。
features: PET maximum-intensity projection: widespread FDG-avid lymphadenopathy with splenic and marrow uptake (panel A)
Flow cytometry: dominant population (about 94%) with CD45 negative/very dim expression on CD45 vs SSC (panel C)
Neoplastic cells CD5 positive but surface CD3 negative, with CD4 expression and variable CD8 (panels B, D)
H&E: diffuse sheets of small to medium lymphoid cells (panel E)
IHC: CD3 and TCL1 positive in tumor cells; third IHC panel largely negative; TCL1 break-apart FISH shows split signals (panels F-H, FISH)
Second flow sample shows a small residual CD45-negative population (about 0.3%) (panels J, K)
61595.describe_en: This composite figure integrates imaging, flow cytometry, histology, immunohistochemistry and FISH. Flow cytometry identifies a dominant abnormal T-cell population that is CD45 negative and surface CD3 negative, yet CD5 positive with CD4 expression and heterogeneous CD8, a phenotype that could be missed with standard CD45/CD3 gating. Tissue shows diffuse sheets of small to medium lymphoid cells that are CD3 and TCL1 positive by immunohistochemistry, and FISH demonstrates TCL1 rearrangement. A later sample shows a small residual population of the same phenotype. Resolution of the panels is limited, but the combination is consistent with T-cell prolymphocytic leukemia with aberrant loss of surface CD3 and CD45.

ddx.vs: T-ALL may lack surface CD3 and be CD4/CD8 double positive, but is TdT/CD1a positive and TCL1 rearrangement negative.
Sezary cells are CD4+ with CD7 and CD26 loss, cerebriform nuclei and no TCL1 overexpression or TCL1 rearrangement.
ATLL is CD4+ CD25+ with flower cells and HTLV-1 seropositivity, lacking TCL1 rearrangement.
CD45 negativity raises this concern, but CD5/CD4 expression by flow and CD3/TCL1 by IHC establish T-cell lineage.

61595.stain: Flow cytometry; H&E; IHC: CD3, TCL1; FISH: TCL1

61531.recognize_zh: 低倍十二指腸黏膜，表面上皮刷狀緣與隱窩腔面 CD10 強陽性（正常內部對照），右側黏膜固有層內擴張的淋巴細胞結節呈較弱但明確的 CD10 陽性，顯示濾泡中心細胞來源，符合十二指腸型濾泡性淋巴瘤。
features: Low-power duodenal mucosa with villi and crypts
Strong CD10 staining of the enterocyte brush border and crypt luminal surfaces (internal control)
Expanded nodular lymphoid infiltrate in the mucosa with weak to moderate CD10 positivity
Surrounding interfollicular lamina propria lymphocytes largely CD10 negative
No CD10-positive cells infiltrating epithelium in this field
61531.describe_en: Duodenal mucosal biopsy stained for CD10 shows strong brush-border and luminal staining of the surface and crypt epithelium, serving as an internal control. A nodular lymphoid infiltrate expanding the lamina propria shows weak to moderate CD10 positivity, while the interfollicular lymphocytes are largely negative. In conjunction with BCL2 co-expression in the nodular B-cell population, findings support a germinal center-derived neoplasm, consistent with duodenal-type follicular lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Reactive germinal centers are also CD10+ but are BCL2 negative, show polarization, tingible body macrophages, and a high Ki-67 index.
MALT lymphoma is CD10 and BCL6 negative, with marginal zone cells colonizing follicles and forming lymphoepithelial lesions.
Mantle cell lymphoma is CD10 negative and CD5+, cyclin D1+, and SOX11+.

61467.recognize_zh: 一顆大型巨噬／單核細胞具豐富空泡狀細胞質，其內與邊緣有數顆褐黑色瘧色素（hemozoin）顆粒；旁邊帶狀與分葉中性球也含褐色顆粒，周圍紅血球內可見細小環狀體，符合惡性瘧原蟲感染的含色素吞噬細胞。
features: Large macrophage/monocyte with abundant finely vacuolated pale cytoplasm and an oval nucleus
Several discrete brown-black hemozoin pigment granules within and at the edge of the macrophage cytoplasm
Adjacent band and segmented neutrophils containing small brown pigment granules
Many surrounding erythrocytes contain small ring forms, some with double chromatin dots
Faint area at the lower-left edge with smudged nuclear material
61467.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a large macrophage with abundant vacuolated cytoplasm containing several discrete brown-black hemozoin pigment granules, adjacent to band and segmented neutrophils that also contain brown pigment. The surrounding erythrocytes are of normal size and many contain small, delicate ring forms, some with double chromatin dots. No schizonts are seen. Findings are consistent with Plasmodium falciparum malaria with pigment-laden phagocytes (macrophage and neutrophils).

ddx.vs: Hemosiderin is golden-yellow, coarse and Prussian blue positive, whereas hemozoin is brown-black, Prussian blue negative and accompanies intraerythrocytic parasites.
Melanin is fine brown granules in tumor cells or histiocytes without a background of ring-form parasitemia.
Precipitate is dark purple-black and lies on the slide surface across cells, not refractile brown granules within phagocytes.
Vivax also produces pigment-laden phagocytes but shows enlarged red cells with Schüffner dots and ameboid trophozoites.

61403.recognize_zh: 流式細胞儀 CD5（y 軸）對 CD3（x 軸）點圖，圈選淋巴球：紫色為 CD3 陰性細胞，紅色 CD4 T 細胞 CD5 較亮，綠色 CD8 T 細胞 CD5 稍暗，藍色小群 CD3 最亮、CD5 偏暗，對應 γδ T 細胞。
features: Dot plot of lymphocyte gate: CD5-PB (y-axis) versus CD3-PC5.5 (x-axis), color-coded by T-cell subset
Magenta CD3-negative, CD5-negative population (B and NK cells)
Red CD4+ T cells with moderate CD3 and the brightest CD5
Green CD8+ T cells with similar CD3 but slightly dimmer, more spread CD5
Small blue population with the brightest CD3 and dim-to-moderate CD5, corresponding to gamma/delta T cells
61403.describe_en: Flow cytometric dot plot gated on lymphocytes displays CD5 versus CD3 expression. A CD3-negative, CD5-negative population (magenta) represents non-T lymphocytes. Three CD3-positive T-cell subsets are color-coded: CD4 T cells (red) with the brightest CD5, CD8 T cells (green) with slightly dimmer CD5, and a small population (blue) with the brightest CD3 and relatively dimmer CD5. The bright-CD3/dim-CD5 phenotype is characteristic of gamma/delta T cells, a normal minor subset; this should not be mistaken for aberrant CD5 loss without further markers such as TCR gamma/delta and clonality assessment.

ddx.dx: T-cell lymphoma with aberrant CD5 loss
ddx.vs: Neoplastic T cells show a discrete population with markedly diminished or absent CD5, often with other aberrancies (CD7 loss, abnormal CD3 intensity) and clonality, rather than a small normal-appearing bright-CD3 subset.
Gamma/delta T cells form an expanded clonal population, usually CD4-/CD8-, CD5-negative and CD56-positive, with hepatosplenomegaly.

ddx.dx: CD5-negative reactive CD8 T cells / NK-like T cells
ddx.vs: These show CD5-dim CD8+ cells without the bright CD3 intensity; TCR gamma/delta staining separates them.

61339.recognize_zh: 視野中數顆淋巴樣細胞的細胞核有深刻摺痕，呈腦迴狀（cerebriform）或多葉花瓣狀（左上一顆藍色細胞質內核分成數個圓葉；中左與右側兩顆核呈 U 形、腸道樣卷曲），染色質緻密，與下方小淋巴球比較明顯異常，符合 Sézary 型細胞侵犯骨髓。
features: Cells with deeply grooved, gyriform (cerebriform) nuclei and minimal cytoplasm (center-left and right)
Larger cell with basophilic cytoplasm and a nucleus divided into multiple rounded lobes (upper left)
Condensed, finely grooved chromatin without prominent nucleoli
Small mature lymphocyte with round nucleus for comparison (bottom center)
Background red cells with stain precipitate; partial neutrophil at bottom edge
61339.describe_en: Aspirate smear shows several atypical lymphoid cells with markedly convoluted nuclei, including cells with deeply grooved gyriform (cerebriform) nuclei and scant cytoplasm and a larger cell with basophilic cytoplasm and a multilobated nucleus. The chromatin is condensed and nucleoli are inconspicuous, in contrast to an adjacent small round lymphocyte. Stain precipitate is present in the background. In the setting of cutaneous T-cell lymphoma, the findings are consistent with marrow involvement by Sézary-type cells, to be confirmed by flow cytometry or immunohistochemistry.

ddx.vs: Flower cells with polylobated nuclei may be indistinguishable, so CD25 positivity and HTLV-1 serology are needed.
Have U-shaped nuclei but with pink secondary granules in abundant cytoplasm rather than scant agranular cytoplasm around a grooved nucleus.
Folded nuclei have delicate lacy chromatin, nucleoli and abundant gray cytoplasm, with nonspecific esterase positivity.
Cells have a visible central nucleolus and cytoplasmic protrusions with TCL1A rearrangement rather than cerebriform grooves.

61211.recognize_zh: 這是 CSF 的流式細胞圖：CD45 閘內幾乎全是淋巴球，黑色的異常 T 細胞占 64%，表現 CD3+、CD16/56+、CD5 陰性（CD5 丟失）且 CD7 亮陽性，與橘/藍色的正常 CD4/CD8 T 細胞明顯分開。
features: Six-panel flow cytometry of CSF: viable cells 97.7%, lymphocytes 99.96% of CD45+ events, CD3+ cells 91.8%
Abnormal T-cell population (black) comprises 64.15% of lymphocytes and shows broad forward scatter, reflecting variable cell size
Abnormal cells are CD3+ and CD16/56+, separating from CD16/56-negative residual T cells (27.5%) and CD3-negative NK cells (green, 8.2%)
CD5 is lost on the abnormal T cells, whereas normal CD4+ (orange) and CD8+ (blue) T cells retain CD5
CD7 is brightly expressed on the abnormal population, brighter than on normal T cells
61211.describe_en: Flow cytometric analysis of the cerebrospinal fluid shows that virtually all leukocytes are CD45-bright lymphocytes. An abnormal T-cell population accounting for 64% of lymphocytes is identified; it is CD3 positive, CD16/56 positive and CD5 negative with bright CD7 expression, and shows heterogeneous forward scatter indicating variable cell size. Residual normal CD4+ and CD8+ T cells retain CD5, and a small CD3-negative NK-cell population is present. In the clinical context, the findings are consistent with CSF involvement by the patient's known peripheral T-cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Reactive CSF T cells retain CD5 and show a normal CD4:CD8 mixture without a discrete antigen-aberrant population.

T-LGL cells are also CD3+CD8+CD16/56+ often with dim CD5/CD7, but typically lack CNS involvement and usually show dim or lost CD7 rather than bright CD7; clinical history and TCR clonality are decisive.
NK/T-cell lymphoma cells are usually surface CD3-negative with CD56+ and EBER positivity, unlike this surface CD3-positive population.

61147.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中央有一顆巨大的雙核（多葉）細胞，胞質充滿細密紫紅色的嗜異染顆粒（metachromatic granules）並向外散出，旁邊還有數顆較小的顆粒性細胞，這種大型、多核、顆粒滿布的細胞是非典型肥大細胞的表現。
features: Very large cell with two (or multilobated) round nuclei largely obscured by granules
Cytoplasm packed with fine purple-red metachromatic granules that extend beyond the cell margin
Scattered smaller mononuclear cells nearby also contain similar metachromatic granules
Background of erythroid precursors, lymphocytes and occasional myeloid cells with rouleaux-like red cell clumping
Free granules dispersed in the background, consistent with degranulation/smearing artifact
61147.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a mixed hematopoietic background with thick, clumped red cells. A strikingly large binucleated/multilobated cell has abundant cytoplasm densely filled with fine metachromatic granules that obscure the nuclei and spill into the surrounding field. Several smaller mononuclear cells with similar granules are present. Multinucleated, highly atypical mast cells of this type are seen in aggressive mast cell neoplasms; findings are consistent with atypical mast cells in mast cell leukemia, pending quantification (≥20% mast cells) and immunophenotyping.

ddx.vs: Megakaryocytes have a single hyperlobated nucleus with fine azurophilic granules and platelet budding, not coarse metachromatic granules obscuring separate nuclei.
Osteoclasts contain many discrete, evenly spaced nuclei with blue-grey cytoplasm and fine azurophilic granules rather than dense metachromatic granules.

ddx.dx: Basophilic blast crisis of CML or acute basophilic leukemia
ddx.vs: Basophilic blasts are smaller with immature chromatin and coarse basophilic granules and are tryptase-negative or weak and CD117-negative, unlike mast cells.

61019.recognize_zh: 視野中央一顆較大的紅血球內，靠近邊緣有一小簇深藍紫色、聚集成團的細小顆粒，即帕彭海默小體（Pappenheimer bodies，含鐵顆粒）；它們比單一圓形的 Howell-Jolly 小體更小、成群出現。
features: Central macrocytic red cell containing a small cluster of 3-4 dark blue-purple granules near the cell periphery
Granules are fine, irregular and grouped, unlike a single round Howell-Jolly body
Anisopoikiocytosis with ovalocytes, occasional teardrop-like and irregular cells
A large polychromatophilic (blue-grey) red cell at the top of the field
Occasional platelets; scattered fine background debris
61019.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows anisopoikilocytosis with ovalocytes and a polychromatophilic macrocyte. A macrocytic red cell in the center contains a small peripheral cluster of fine, dark basophilic granules consistent with Pappenheimer bodies. No leukocytes are present in the field. Pappenheimer bodies are iron-containing (siderotic) inclusions, and their identity can be confirmed with a Prussian blue stain; they suggest hyposplenism, sideroblastic anemia, hemoglobinopathy or dyserythropoiesis depending on context.

ddx.vs: A Howell-Jolly body is a single, larger, perfectly round dense purple DNA remnant rather than a cluster of small granules, and is Prussian blue-negative.
Stippling consists of numerous fine or coarse RNA dots evenly distributed throughout the whole cell, not a localized cluster at one edge, and is iron-stain negative.
An overlying platelet has a pale blue cytoplasmic rim around the granules and lies in a different focal plane.
Ring forms have a blue cytoplasmic ring with a red-purple chromatin dot rather than a clump of dark granules.

60955.recognize_zh: 治療前的母細胞（A）核染色質細、細胞質少量嗜鹼性、僅有空泡而無顆粒；復發後的母細胞（D、E）細胞質變多並充滿粗大紫紅色嗜天青顆粒，看似 AML，但流式仍是 CD22+/CD34+/TdT+、CD19 因 blinatumomab 而消失，IHC CD79a 與 PAX5 陽性，確認為顆粒型 B-ALL 復發。
features: Panel A (pretreatment): large blasts with fine chromatin, scant-moderate basophilic cytoplasm, a few clear cytoplasmic vacuoles, no granules
Panels D-E (relapse): blasts with more abundant cytoplasm containing numerous coarse azurophilic granules and scattered vacuoles; no Auer rods
Panels B-C (pretreatment flow): blasts CD22+/CD34+ with CD19+ and partial TdT
Panels F-G (relapse flow): blasts CD34+/CD22+ with partial TdT but CD19 negative (antigen loss after blinatumomab)
Panels H-I (IHC): blasts strongly positive for CD79a (membranous/cytoplasmic) and PAX5 (nuclear)
60955.describe_en: Pretreatment bone marrow aspirate shows blasts with fine chromatin and scant basophilic, agranular cytoplasm with occasional vacuoles. The relapse specimen shows blasts with more abundant cytoplasm containing numerous coarse azurophilic granules, morphologically mimicking myeloblasts, without Auer rods. Flow cytometry of the relapse shows CD34+, CD22+, partial TdT+ blasts that have lost CD19 following blinatumomab, and immunohistochemistry demonstrates CD79a and PAX5 positivity; cytochemical MPO and nonspecific esterase were negative per report. Findings are consistent with relapsed B-lymphoblastic leukemia with granular morphology and CD19-negative escape.

ddx.vs: Granular blasts in AML are MPO-positive, may contain Auer rods and express CD13/CD33/CD117 without CD22, CD79a or PAX5.

ddx.dx: Mixed-phenotype acute leukemia or lineage switch to AML after CD19-directed therapy
ddx.vs: Would show acquisition of MPO or monocytic markers (CD14, CD64, lysozyme) with loss of B-lineage markers, which are retained here.
Blasts have deeply basophilic cytoplasm with lipid vacuoles but no azurophilic granules, and are TdT/CD34-negative with surface light chain and MYC rearrangement.
Granular cells are CD56-positive with cytotoxic granules and lack CD34, TdT, CD22 and PAX5.

60891.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中紅血球系前驅細胞明顯增加，許多晚期（正色性與多染性）幼紅血球為雙核，兩個核大小相近、圓形緻密，另可見三至四核細胞，這種晚期幼紅血球的雙核／多核現象是 CDA type II 的特徵。
features: Increased erythroid precursors, predominantly late polychromatic and orthochromatic normoblasts
Numerous binucleated late erythroblasts with two equal-sized, round, dense nuclei
Occasional multinucleated erythroblasts with three to four nuclei
Maturing granulocytes present; one immature cell with coarse granules
Red cells show anisopoikilocytosis in the background
60891.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate shows erythroid hyperplasia with a predominance of late-stage erythroblasts. Many polychromatic and orthochromatic normoblasts are binucleated with two equal-sized round nuclei, and occasional multinucleated erythroblasts are present; internuclear chromatin bridges are not evident. Granulocytic maturation is present, and the background red cells show anisopoikilocytosis. Findings are consistent with congenital dyserythropoietic anemia type II.

ddx.vs: CDA I shows megaloblastoid erythroblasts with internuclear chromatin bridges and Swiss cheese heterochromatin on EM rather than predominant late binucleated normoblasts.
CDA III features giant multinucleated erythroblasts with up to 12 nuclei, far larger than the binucleated forms here.
MDS occurs in adults with multilineage dysplasia, ring sideroblasts or clonal cytogenetic changes; CDA II is congenital with SEC23B mutation and a hypoglycosylated band 3 on SDS-PAGE.
HS shows erythroid hyperplasia without significant binuclearity and has spherocytes with abnormal EMA binding but normal band 3 glycosylation.

60827.recognize_zh: 高倍下可見成群的大型多形性細胞，核呈多葉或腎形、染色質空泡狀、具明顯核仁，外觀類似何杰金/RS 細胞，但排列成片、沿血管周圍分布，並有凋亡細胞與纖維化背景，屬於灰區淋巴瘤的形態。
features: Large atypical cells with polylobated, folded or kidney-shaped vesicular nuclei and distinct nucleoli, resembling Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg and lacunar-like cells
Moderate pale amphophilic cytoplasm, some with retraction clefts/clear halos
Cells arranged in cohesive-appearing clusters and sheets, partly around small blood vessels
Scattered apoptotic/pyknotic cells and small lymphocytes
Background of eosinophilic fibrinous/sclerotic stroma (lower left)
60827.describe_en: High-power section shows clusters and sheets of large pleomorphic cells with polylobated or folded vesicular nuclei, prominent nucleoli and moderate pale cytoplasm, including Hodgkin-like and lacunar-like forms, distributed around small vessels. Scattered apoptotic cells and small lymphocytes are present, and there is adjacent eosinophilic fibrinous/sclerotic stroma. The sheet-like growth of Hodgkin-like cells with a relatively sparse inflammatory background does not fit classic Hodgkin lymphoma or typical large B-cell lymphoma cleanly. In conjunction with the immunophenotype (CD20/Oct-2 retained, CD15 positive, CD30 limited), findings are consistent with a B-cell lymphoma with features intermediate between DLBCL and classic Hodgkin lymphoma.

ddx.dx: Classic Hodgkin lymphoma, syncytial variant of nodular sclerosis
ddx.vs: Syncytial cHL has sheets of HRS cells but they are strongly CD30+/CD15+ with loss of CD20 and Oct-2, and a mixed eosinophil-rich background.
PMBL cells are more monotonous with clear cytoplasm and fine compartmentalizing fibrosis, with strong uniform CD20 and absent CD15.
ALCL has hallmark cells with horseshoe nuclei growing in sinuses, uniformly strong CD30 and a T-cell/null phenotype without B-cell markers.

ddx.dx: Metastatic carcinoma or germ cell tumor
ddx.vs: Cohesive epithelial or germ cell tumors express keratin, SALL4 or OCT3/4 and lack CD45 and B-cell markers.

60763.recognize_zh: 八格組圖中的紅血球系前驅細胞（深藍色細胞質、圓核、細顆粒染色質的原紅血球母細胞到較小的晚期紅血球母細胞）邊緣出現許多細小棘狀突起、偽足或小泡狀外突，使細胞輪廓變形，這是 HHV-6 相關幼兒暫時性紅血球母細胞減少症所描述的紅血球母細胞變形。
features: Panels A-B: large proerythroblasts with deeply basophilic cytoplasm, round nuclei, finely granular chromatin and small cytoplasmic blebs at the margin
Panels C, E-G: basophilic erythroblasts with irregular outlines bearing multiple fine spiky or filamentous cytoplasmic projections and pseudopods
Panel G: two adjacent erythroblasts with circumferential hair-like projections
Panels D and H: smaller, later-stage erythroblasts with condensed chromatin and irregular, tailed cytoplasmic outlines
Background of normocytic red cells and occasional neutrophils; cells are cropped, so overall erythroid quantity cannot be judged
60763.describe_en: Composite of cropped cells (A-H) from a Wright-Giemsa-stained smear shows erythroid precursors ranging from proerythroblasts with deeply basophilic cytoplasm and finely granular chromatin to smaller late erythroblasts with condensed chromatin. Many of these cells display marked cytoplasmic deformation with blebs, pseudopods and fine spiky or filamentous projections around the cell margin. The images do not allow assessment of overall erythroid cellularity or of viral inclusions. In the setting of HHV-6 infection with reticulocytopenia in a young child, findings are consistent with the deformed erythroblasts described in transient erythroblastopenia of childhood.

ddx.dx: Parvovirus B19-associated pure red cell aplasia
ddx.vs: Shows giant proerythroblasts with glassy intranuclear inclusions and vacuolated cytoplasm with 'dog-ear' projections, whereas TEC erythroblasts lack giant forms and nuclear inclusions.
Presents in infancy with macrocytosis, elevated fetal hemoglobin and eADA, congenital anomalies and ribosomal protein gene mutations, without spontaneous recovery.
Consists of sheets of pronormoblasts with vacuoles and TP53 mutation, rather than scattered reactive erythroblasts in a self-limited childhood anemia.
Megakaryoblasts also show cytoplasmic blebs but express CD41/CD61, and lymphoblasts have scant pale cytoplasm; erythroblasts here are CD71/glycophorin/E-cadherin lineage.

60571.recognize_zh: 抹片中大型巨噬細胞胞質呈淡藍色泡沫／網狀空泡（foamy），切片中泡沫狀組織球大片取代造血組織，CD68 強陽性；此即假性尼曼匹克細胞（pseudo–Niemann-Pick cells），與高三酸甘油脂血症相關。
features: Aspirate: large macrophages with abundant pale blue, finely vacuolated (foamy, soap-bubble) cytoplasm and small eccentric nuclei
Foamy macrophages form clusters admixed with hematopoietic cells
Core biopsy: extensive interstitial replacement by pale, vacuolated histiocytes with reduced hematopoiesis
Special stain panel shows pale foamy cells with little staining of the cytoplasm
CD68 immunostain diffusely positive, highlighting sheets of histiocytes
60571.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smears show numerous large macrophages with abundant, finely vacuolated foamy cytoplasm and small eccentric nuclei. The core biopsy shows extensive infiltration of the marrow space by sheets of foamy histiocytes with a corresponding reduction in hematopoietic elements. The histiocytes are strongly and diffusely positive for CD68. Findings are consistent with lipid-laden pseudo–Niemann-Pick cells; in the setting of pancytopenia and marked hypertriglyceridemia this represents a secondary lipid storage phenomenon, and a primary lysosomal storage disorder should be excluded by enzyme or genetic testing.

ddx.vs: True Niemann-Pick cells are morphologically similar and are separated by acid sphingomyelinase activity or SMPD1/NPC gene testing rather than morphology.
Gaucher cells have fibrillary 'crumpled tissue-paper' cytoplasm rather than round bubbly vacuoles.
Sea-blue histiocytes contain blue-green ceroid granules on Romanowsky stain rather than clear foamy vacuoles.

ddx.dx: Mycobacterial or fungal infection with foamy histiocytes
ddx.vs: Infectious foamy histiocytes contain organisms demonstrable by AFB, GMS or PAS stains and are often associated with granulomas.

60571.stain: Wright-Giemsa; H&E; special stain; IHC: CD68

60635.recognize_zh: 骨髓中細胞核偏心、形似漿細胞的腫瘤細胞，細胞質內有大空泡把核推擠成新月形（印戒樣），空泡中央可見嗜酸性小點（標靶樣）；免疫染色顯示細胞質／空泡周圍環狀陽性與核陽性，證實為轉移性乳小葉癌而非多發性骨髓瘤。
features: Panel A (clot/biopsy section): sheets of discohesive plasmacytoid cells with eccentric, hyperchromatic nuclei
Many cells contain large intracytoplasmic vacuoles compressing the nucleus into a crescent (signet-ring morphology)
Panel B (aspirate): single cell with eccentric nucleus and a large pale intracytoplasmic vacuole with a central targetoid dot (intracytoplasmic lumen)
Panel C: strong cytoplasmic immunostaining accentuated around the vacuoles (consistent with cytokeratin; antigen not labeled)
Panel D: nuclear immunostaining of tumor cells (consistent with a hormone receptor or GATA3; antigen not labeled)
60635.describe_en: Bone marrow section shows diffuse infiltration by discohesive tumor cells with eccentric nuclei and abundant cytoplasm, many containing intracytoplasmic vacuoles that indent the nucleus, imparting a plasmacytoid to signet-ring appearance. The aspirate shows a single plasmacytoid cell with a large intracytoplasmic lumen containing a central targetoid inclusion, a feature of lobular carcinoma rather than plasma cells. Immunohistochemistry shows strong cytoplasmic staining rimming the vacuoles and nuclear positivity in the tumor cells; antigens are not labeled in the figure. Findings are consistent with metastatic lobular breast carcinoma mimicking multiple myeloma; confirmation with cytokeratin, GATA3/ER and E-cadherin loss with negative CD138/light chains is advised.

ddx.vs: Myeloma cells have clock-face chromatin and a perinuclear hof without intracytoplasmic lumina, and are CD138 and light-chain restricted but cytokeratin negative.
Morphology overlaps; gastric carcinoma is CDX2/CK20 positive and GATA3/ER negative, whereas lobular breast carcinoma is GATA3/ER positive with E-cadherin loss.

ddx.dx: Mott cells / plasma cells with Russell bodies
ddx.vs: Mott cells contain multiple round glassy immunoglobulin inclusions rather than a single mucin-filled lumen with a targetoid dot and are cytokeratin negative.
Lipid-laden histiocytes have small central nuclei and multiple clear vacuoles, and are CD68/CD163 positive and keratin negative.

60699.recognize_zh: 乍看核圓、染色質粗塊狀像晚期紅血球母細胞，但細胞質是淡紫灰色且含細小顆粒（箭頭），並非含血紅素的粉紅色細胞質，核也有輕微凹陷或雙葉傾向，實為核分葉不足的嗜中性球（Pelger 型）。
features: Mature-sized cells with round to slightly indented or bilobed nuclei and coarsely clumped chromatin
Moderate pale lilac-gray cytoplasm containing fine neutrophilic granules (arrows in B)
Cytoplasm lacks the orange-pink hemoglobinization expected of an orthochromatic erythroblast
Nucleus lacks the dense homogeneous pyknosis of a late normoblast; chromatin shows the patchy clumping of mature granulocytes
Background red cells and platelets unremarkable
60699.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows granulocytes with round or minimally indented, non-segmented nuclei and coarse clumped chromatin surrounded by a moderate amount of pale lilac cytoplasm containing fine specific granules. Although the round nuclei superficially resemble nucleated red cells, the granular non-hemoglobinized cytoplasm identifies these cells as neutrophils. Findings are consistent with hyposegmented (Pelger-Huët–type) neutrophils; distinguishing the inherited anomaly from acquired pseudo-Pelger change requires review of the proportion of affected cells, family history, medications and exclusion of myelodysplasia.

ddx.vs: Nucleated red cells have a small dense pyknotic nucleus in pink-orange hemoglobinized cytoplasm without granules.
Myelocytes are larger with less condensed chromatin and a Golgi zone, lacking the coarse mature chromatin clumping of these cells.
Lymphocytes have scant, clear-blue agranular cytoplasm or a basophilic rim, not a moderate lilac granular cytoplasm.
Morphology overlaps, so separation relies on a minority of affected neutrophils with hypogranulation and a clinical or clonal cause versus uniform involvement in the inherited LBR-related anomaly.

captions: Two neutrophils with round/indented nuclei and clumped chromatin mimicking erythroblasts
High power: fine neutrophilic granules in pale cytoplasm (arrows)
Another hyposegmented neutrophil with coarse clumped chromatin

60443.recognize_zh: 低細胞量骨髓中 CD61（紅色色原）標示巨核細胞：可見一顆核圓形、未分葉的巨核細胞，以及數顆與周圍造血細胞差不多大小的小型 CD61 陽性細胞（微小巨核細胞 micromegakaryocytes），提示巨核細胞發育異常。
features: Hypocellular marrow with abundant fat and thin cords of hematopoietic cells
CD61-positive megakaryocyte with a single round, non-lobated nucleus
Several small CD61-positive mononuclear cells the size of surrounding precursors (micromegakaryocytes)
Scattered fine positive platelet granules in the background
Red chromogen with hematoxylin counterstain
60443.describe_en: CD61 immunostain on a hypocellular bone marrow biopsy highlights megakaryocytes, including a megakaryocyte with a round, non-lobated nucleus and several small mononuclear CD61-positive cells comparable in size to adjacent precursors, consistent with micromegakaryocytes. The background shows abundant fat with thin hematopoietic cords. In a child with pancytopenia and a hypocellular marrow, dysplastic megakaryocytes favor refractory cytopenia of childhood over aplastic anemia. Findings are consistent with refractory cytopenia of childhood (childhood MDS with low blasts).

ddx.vs: Aplastic anemia shows absent or rare megakaryocytes without micromegakaryocytes or other unequivocal dysplasia.

ddx.dx: Inherited bone marrow failure syndrome (e.g., Fanconi anemia)
ddx.vs: Morphology can overlap; chromosome breakage testing and germline sequencing are needed for distinction.

ddx.dx: Reactive megakaryocytic changes (e.g., drugs, infection, nutritional deficiency)
ddx.vs: Reactive changes are usually transient and lack micromegakaryocytes and clonal cytogenetic abnormalities.

60187.recognize_zh: 高倍骨髓切片正中央有一個巨核細胞，細胞質豐富粉紅，但細胞核分成四個彼此完全分離的圓形小核（separated nuclear lobes），是 MDS 典型的巨核細胞發育異常。
features: Large megakaryocyte with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm
Nucleus divided into four widely separated, round, non-connected lobes
Individual lobes small with vesicular chromatin and small nucleoli
Surrounding hematopoietic cells include erythroid precursors and granulocytic cells
Adjacent fat space; background marrow cellular
60187.describe_en: High-power view of the H&E-stained bone marrow trephine shows a large megakaryocyte with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm and multiple (four) widely separated, round nuclear lobes that are not connected to one another. The surrounding marrow contains erythroid and granulocytic precursors. This separated-lobe ("pawn ball") megakaryocyte is a characteristic dysplastic form and, together with other dysplastic features and increased blasts, supports myelodysplastic syndrome with excess blasts.

ddx.vs: Occasional multinucleated megakaryocytes can be reactive, but they are infrequent and lack the accompanying multilineage dysplasia and clonal abnormalities of MDS.
MPN megakaryocytes are large with hyperlobated but connected (staghorn) or bulbous hyperchromatic nuclei rather than discrete separated round lobes.
Osteoclasts lie along bone surfaces and contain many uniform, evenly distributed nuclei, whereas megakaryocytes lie in the marrow space and are CD61 positive.

60123.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片低倍看細胞量略增，高倍幾乎全是核圓、深染、周圍有清晰細胞質暈的紅血球前驅細胞成片分布，巨核細胞少見、無芽細胞增加；呈現溶血驅動的紅系增生，而非腫瘤。
features: Low power: mildly hypercellular core with preserved bony trabeculae and interspersed fat
High power: sheets and clusters of erythroid precursors with round, dark, condensed nuclei and perinuclear halos
Relative decrease in myeloid precursors and megakaryocytes
No sheets of immature cells or increased blasts
Interstitial hemorrhage/red cells in the background
60123.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at low power is mildly hypercellular for age, with preserved trabecular bone and interspersed fat. At high power, the marrow is dominated by sheets of erythroid precursors with round, hyperchromatic nuclei and perinuclear cytoplasmic halos, while myeloid precursors and megakaryocytes are decreased. No increase in blasts or abnormal infiltrate is identified. Findings show erythroid hyperplasia consistent with a hemolytic process such as paroxysmal nocturnal hemoglobinuria; PNH is confirmed by flow cytometry for GPI-anchored proteins (FLAER, CD59).

ddx.dx: Other hemolytic anemias (e.g., autoimmune hemolytic anemia)
ddx.vs: Marrow morphology is identical; a positive DAT favors AIHA, whereas FLAER/CD59 loss on flow cytometry defines PNH.
Pure erythroid leukemia shows sheets of large atypical proerythroblasts (>30% of cells) rather than maturing normoblasts.
Megaloblastic erythroid precursors are enlarged with open, sieve-like chromatin and nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony, unlike the small condensed nuclei here.

60059.recognize_zh: 流式圖中紅色母細胞族群位於 CD45 弱/陰性、低 SSC 區，呈 CD19+、CD34+、CD10+、HLA-DR+，同時在 CD13 對 CD34 圖上明顯 CD13 陽性，但 CD117、CD33、CD20 陰性；這是帶有髓系抗原 CD13 異常表現的 B-ALL，此類異常表現常見於 Ph+（BCR::ABL1 p190）病例。
features: CD45 vs SSC: red blast population (about 27%) with dim-to-negative CD45 and low SSC, separate from granulocytes (green) and lymphocytes (blue)
CD19 vs CD34 and CD19 vs CD45: blasts are CD19 positive and CD34 positive with dim CD45
CD13 vs CD34: blasts clearly CD13 positive (aberrant myeloid antigen), in the CD34+ quadrant separate from CD34-negative granulocytes
CD117 vs CD34 and HLA-DR vs CD33: blasts CD117 negative, HLA-DR positive, CD33 negative
CD10 vs CD20: blasts CD10 positive with variable intensity and CD20 negative
60059.describe_en: Flow cytometric analysis of peripheral blood shows an abnormal population (red) of approximately 27% of events in the dim-to-negative CD45, low side-scatter region. The blasts express CD19, CD34, CD10, HLA-DR, and aberrant CD13, and are negative for CD117, CD33, CD20, and surface light chains. Residual granulocytes (CD13 positive, CD34 negative) and CD45-bright lymphocytes serve as internal controls. This immunophenotype is consistent with B-lymphoblastic leukemia with aberrant CD13 expression; with the reported t(9;22) p190 transcript, the diagnosis is B-lymphoblastic leukemia with BCR::ABL1 fusion.

ddx.vs: CD13 or CD33 alone is insufficient for myeloid lineage; MPAL requires MPO positivity (or monocytic markers), which is not demonstrated here.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with aberrant CD19
ddx.vs: AML with t(8;21) may express CD19 and CD34, but blasts are CD117 and MPO positive and lack strong B-lineage CD10/CD79a/CD22 coexpression.
Shares BCR::ABL1 and a B-lymphoblast phenotype; distinguished by prior chronic phase, p210 transcript, and BCR::ABL1 in neutrophils.
Hematogones lack aberrant myeloid antigens and show a maturing CD34/CD10/CD20 continuum with normal CD45.

29403.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片可見組織球吞噬紅血球前驅細胞與嗜中性球（hemophagocytosis），旁邊有核形不規則、胞質嗜鹼帶空泡的大型異常細胞；切片出現腎形核的 hallmark cell 且 CD30 強陽性，支持 ALCL 引起的噬血現象。
features: Large histiocyte with abundant pale cytoplasm containing an engulfed erythroid precursor and a neutrophil (hemophagocytosis, panel A black arrow)
Adjacent large atypical cell with irregular, folded nucleus and deeply basophilic vacuolated cytoplasm (panel A red arrow)
Marrow biopsy with sheets of large pleomorphic cells with vesicular nuclei, prominent nucleoli and a hallmark cell with horseshoe/kidney-shaped nucleus (panel B)
Strong, diffuse membranous and Golgi-pattern CD30 staining of the large neoplastic cells (panel C)
29403.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows prominent hemophagocytosis, with a histiocyte engulfing an erythroid precursor and a neutrophil, and an adjacent large atypical cell with an irregular nuclear contour and deeply basophilic, vacuolated cytoplasm. The core biopsy shows a diffuse infiltrate of large pleomorphic cells with vesicular chromatin and conspicuous nucleoli, including hallmark cells with eccentric kidney-shaped nuclei. By immunohistochemistry, the large cells show strong membranous and Golgi-pattern CD30 expression. In the context of ALK negativity and a T-cell phenotype, findings are consistent with marrow involvement by anaplastic large cell lymphoma, ALK-negative, with secondary hemophagocytosis.

ddx.vs: Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells are scattered in a mixed inflammatory background and are CD15-positive, PAX5 weak-positive and CD45/T-cell antigen negative, rather than forming cohesive sheets of CD30+ T cells.
Morphology is essentially identical, so ALK immunohistochemistry (nuclear/cytoplasmic) and ALK rearrangement separate it from the ALK-negative case.
Reactive HLH shows hemophagocytic histiocytes without sheets of large atypical CD30-positive lymphoid cells.
Carcinoma is keratin-positive and CD45-negative, and DLBCL expresses B-cell markers (CD20, PAX5) rather than T-cell antigens with uniform strong CD30.

27675.recognize_zh: H&E 呈中至大型非典型淋巴細胞瀰漫片狀浸潤；免疫染色 CD3 瀰漫強陽性（T 細胞來源）、CD30 瀰漫強陽性、CD4 僅部分弱陽性，PET 顯示腹部多處高代謝淋巴結——符合周邊 T 細胞淋巴瘤（此例 CD30 陽性）。
features: H&E: diffuse sheets of medium-to-large atypical lymphoid cells with irregular hyperchromatic nuclei
CD3: strong, diffuse membranous/cytoplasmic staining of the neoplastic cells
CD30: strong, diffuse membranous and Golgi-pattern staining in most tumor cells
CD4: patchy, weaker staining, suggesting partial loss or subset expression
PET-CT (panel B): multiple FDG-avid abdominal/retroperitoneal nodal lesions
27675.describe_en: Section shows effacement by diffuse sheets of medium-to-large atypical lymphoid cells with irregular, hyperchromatic nuclei. By immunohistochemistry, the neoplastic cells are diffusely positive for CD3 and CD30, with patchy, weaker CD4 expression. The accompanying axial PET-CT image demonstrates multiple FDG-avid intra-abdominal nodal lesions. Findings are consistent with a CD30-positive peripheral T-cell lymphoma; ALK status, TFH markers and T-cell clonality are needed to exclude ALK-negative anaplastic large cell lymphoma and nodal TFH-cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: ALCL shows cohesive hallmark cells with horseshoe nuclei and uniformly strong CD30 with frequent loss of CD3, and may carry DUSP22 or TP63 rearrangements.
ALK-positive ALCL is identified by ALK protein expression (nuclear/cytoplasmic with NPM1::ALK), usually in young patients.

ddx.dx: Nodal T-follicular helper cell lymphoma, angioimmunoblastic type
ddx.vs: AITL has a polymorphous background, arborizing HEVs, expanded CD21+ FDC meshworks and tumor cells expressing PD1, ICOS, CXCL13 and CD10.
Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells are scattered in a reactive background, CD15+/CD30+/PAX5 weak and usually CD3-negative, rather than forming CD3+ sheets.

27675.stain: H&E; IHC: CD4, CD3, CD30; PET-CT

13019.recognize_zh: C 圖周邊血中多顆中型淋巴球的核呈多葉花瓣狀（箭頭，flower cells），另一顆核有深裂痕（箭頭尖），配合 A、B 圖皮膚圓形脫屑、色素減退病灶，提示 HTLV-1 相關成人 T 細胞白血病／淋巴瘤（ATLL）。
features: PB (C): marked lymphocytosis of medium-sized cells with polylobated, petal-like nuclei (flower cells, arrows)
PB (C): lymphocyte with deep nuclear clefts (arrowhead); condensed chromatin without nucleoli
PB (C): scant basophilic agranular cytoplasm
Clinical photos (A, B): widespread annular, desquamating, hypopigmented skin lesions on the arm and trunk/back
No blasts or dysplastic myeloid cells in the blood field shown
13019.describe_en: Clinical photographs show widespread annular, desquamating, hypopigmented skin lesions on the extremity and trunk. The peripheral blood smear shows numerous medium-sized lymphoid cells with condensed chromatin, scant basophilic cytoplasm, and markedly polylobated, petal-like nuclei (flower cells), together with cells showing deep nuclear clefts. No nucleoli or blastic chromatin are evident. Findings are consistent with adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma, supported by the CD4+/CD25+ T-cell phenotype and HTLV-1 positivity.

ddx.vs: Sézary cells have cerebriform grooved nuclei rather than petal-like polylobation, and the patient is HTLV-1 negative with typical erythroderma.
T-PLL cells have a single visible nucleolus and cytoplasmic blebs and carry TCL1A rearrangement, without flower-cell polylobation.

ddx.dx: Chronic lymphocytic leukemia with atypical morphology
ddx.vs: CLL cells are B cells (CD5+/CD23+/CD20 dim) with round nuclei and smudge cells, not CD4+/CD25+ T cells.
Reactive lymphocytes are heterogeneous with abundant cytoplasm hugging red cells and lack the monotonous polylobated nuclei.

12955.recognize_zh: 左圖可見大量各成熟階段的顆粒球（骨髓細胞、後骨髓細胞、桿狀核與分葉中性球）與嗜鹼性球，代表 CML 的左移增生；其間混有小而圓、染色質塊狀的成熟淋巴球，右圖則有多個破碎的塗抹細胞（smudge cells），提示同時存在 CLL。
features: Left: leukocytosis with the full spectrum of granulocytic maturation (myelocytes, metamyelocytes, bands, segmented neutrophils)
Left: occasional basophil with dark granules; no increase in blasts evident
Left: admixed small mature lymphocytes with round nuclei, clumped soccer-ball chromatin and scant cytoplasm
Right: several smudge (basket) cells in the red cell field
Right: a small mature lymphocyte; red cells normocytic without significant poikilocytosis
12955.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked leukocytosis with a left-shifted granulocytic series including myelocytes, metamyelocytes, bands, and segmented neutrophils, with occasional basophils and no significant increase in blasts. Admixed with the granulocytes is a population of small mature lymphocytes with round nuclei and coarsely clumped chromatin. Another field shows numerous smudge cells. The combination of a chronic-phase myeloproliferative picture and a mature small lymphocytosis with smudge cells is suggestive of coexisting chronic myeloid leukemia and chronic lymphocytic leukemia; BCR::ABL1 testing and flow cytometry for a CD5+/CD23+ B-cell clone are required.

ddx.dx: Leukemoid reaction in CLL (eg, infection, steroids)
ddx.vs: A reactive neutrophilia shows toxic changes, fewer myelocytes, no basophilia and is BCR::ABL1 negative.
Transformation shows large cells or blasts rather than mature small lymphocytes with full granulocytic maturation.
These are BCR::ABL1 negative and show dysgranulopoiesis or monocytosis rather than basophilia and orderly maturation.

ddx.dx: Mantle cell lymphoma in leukemic phase
ddx.vs: Mantle cells often have irregular nuclear contours and are CD23-negative, cyclin D1/SOX11 positive.

12891.recognize_zh: 左側淋巴球的核分成兩個平行的腎形葉（雙核／雙葉淋巴球，binucleated lymphocyte），細胞質淡藍且中等量，旁邊另有一顆核呈卵圓形的淋巴球；年輕吸菸女性出現此類細胞，典型提示持續性多株 B 細胞淋巴球增多症（PPBL）。
features: Lymphocyte with a bilobed nucleus composed of two parallel, elongated lobes (binucleated appearance)
Moderate amount of pale-blue agranular cytoplasm with slightly irregular borders
Mature chromatin with small indistinct chromocenters; no prominent nucleoli
Adjacent lymphocyte with oval nucleus and a thin rim of pale cytoplasm
Normocytic, normochromic red cells without abnormalities
12891.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a lymphocyte with a bilobed nucleus consisting of two parallel, elongated lobes with mature chromatin and a moderate amount of pale-blue agranular cytoplasm, together with a second lymphocyte with an oval nucleus. Red cells are unremarkable. Binucleated lymphocytes are a characteristic finding in persistent polyclonal B-cell lymphocytosis, typically in young to middle-aged female smokers, often with polyclonal IgM elevation and HLA-DR7 association; flow cytometry demonstrating polyclonal CD27+ memory B cells and cytogenetics for isochromosome 3q are supportive.

ddx.vs: SMZL shows a light-chain-restricted B-cell clone with villous projections rather than polyclonal B cells with bilobed nuclei.
CLL cells are small with round nuclei, clumped chromatin and smudge cells, with a monotypic CD5+/CD23+ B-cell population.
Viral reactive lymphocytes are heterogeneous with abundant basophilic cytoplasm hugging red cells and are transient.
HCL cells have circumferential hairy projections with round/bean-shaped nuclei and are clonal CD103/CD25/CD11c positive with pancytopenia.

11867.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中數顆小至中型淋巴球，染色質濃縮粗糙，核輪廓不規則、帶淺切痕或凹陷，胞質極少；型態不如花瓣細胞典型，但這種不規則核小淋巴球在 HTLV-1 背景下符合 ATLL。
features: Small to medium-sized lymphoid cells with high N:C ratio
Irregular, knobby or notched nuclear outlines; one cell with an indented nucleus
Dense, coarsely clumped chromatin without visible nucleoli
Very scant pale blue cytoplasm with occasional small projections
Background red cells with rouleaux-like stacking and some crenated forms (likely artifact); platelets present
11867.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows several small to medium-sized atypical lymphocytes with scant cytoplasm, dense chromatin and irregular, notched nuclear contours. Classic polylobated flower cells are not present in this field. Red cells show stacking and crenation that are likely preparation artifact; platelets are adequate. The morphology is compatible with adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma in the appropriate clinical and serologic context, but is not specific; flow cytometry and HTLV-1 serology are required.

ddx.vs: Sezary cells show fine cerebriform nuclear grooves in small to large cells and a CD4+CD7-CD26- phenotype without HTLV-1, while ATLL is HTLV-1 positive and CD25 bright.
Small-cell T-PLL has cytoplasmic blebs and a TCL1A or MTCP1 rearrangement with CD7 retained, differing from CD7-negative CD25-positive ATLL.
CLL cells have round nuclei with block-like chromatin and are B-lineage CD5+CD23+, distinguishable by flow cytometry.

2075.recognize_zh: 低倍下淋巴結內佈滿大量大小、形狀不一的次級濾泡，每個都有淡染的生發中心（germinal center）與深色完整的外套層（mantle zone），濾泡間仍保留，符合反應性濾泡增生（reactive follicular hyperplasia）。
features: Numerous secondary lymphoid follicles distributed throughout the cortex and medulla
Follicles vary markedly in size and shape (round, elongated, irregular)
Pale germinal centers surrounded by well-defined, dark, intact mantle zones
Preserved interfollicular areas separating follicles
Thin capsule and fibrous septa without capsular infiltration
2075.describe_en: Low-power H&E section of lymph node shows preserved architecture with numerous secondary follicles of varying size and shape, including elongated and irregular forms, distributed throughout the node. The follicles have pale germinal centers surrounded by crisp, dark mantle zones, and the interfollicular tissue is preserved. There is no back-to-back crowding of monotonous follicles or effacement at this magnification, although germinal center polarization and tingible-body macrophages require higher power. Findings are consistent with reactive follicular hyperplasia.

ddx.vs: Follicular lymphoma shows back-to-back, uniform follicles with attenuated mantles, loss of polarity and tingible-body macrophages, capsular extension, and BCL2 expression in germinal centers.
Castleman follicles have regressed germinal centers with penetrating hyalinized vessels and onion-skin concentric mantles.
Early HIV lymphadenopathy shows florid, irregular follicles with follicle lysis and mantle zone attenuation, requiring clinical and serologic correlation.

1179.recognize_zh: 骨髓抽吸液中小淋巴球、帶偏心核與深藍胞質的漿細胞樣淋巴球（plasmacytoid lymphocytes）以及成熟漿細胞混雜成一個連續光譜，其間散在帶顆粒的嗜酸性細胞；小淋巴球到漿細胞的逐步分化，是淋巴漿細胞淋巴瘤／Waldenström 巨球蛋白血症的抽吸液表現。
features: Spectrum of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid lymphocytes and mature plasma cells
Plasmacytoid cells with eccentric round nuclei, clumped clock-face chromatin and moderately basophilic cytoplasm, some with perinuclear hof
Small lymphocytes with condensed chromatin and scant cytoplasm predominating in clusters
Scattered granulated cells including eosinophils; occasional segmented neutrophils
Mast cells not clearly identified in this field; residual erythroid and myeloid precursors present
1179.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows an increase in lymphoid cells forming a continuous spectrum from small lymphocytes with condensed chromatin to plasmacytoid lymphocytes with eccentric nuclei and basophilic cytoplasm and mature plasma cells with perinuclear hofs. Scattered eosinophils, neutrophils and residual hematopoietic precursors are present. No large transformed cells are evident in this field. In a patient with an IgM paraprotein, the findings are consistent with lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma (Waldenström macroglobulinemia), to be supported by flow cytometry showing a clonal B-cell and plasma cell population and MYD88 L265P testing.

ddx.dx: Marginal zone lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation
ddx.vs: Can be morphologically identical, so MYD88 L265P (present in >90% of LPL) and the pattern of involvement help separate them.
Myeloma consists of clonal plasma cells without an accompanying clonal CD19+/CD20+ B-cell component and often shows CCND1 translocation in IgM cases.

ddx.dx: Chronic lymphocytic leukemia with plasmacytoid features
ddx.vs: CLL has monotonous small lymphocytes with a CD5+/CD23+ phenotype and lacks a prominent plasma cell continuum.
Reactive plasma cells are polytypic with no clonal B-cell population and no monoclonal IgM.

1115.recognize_zh: 抹片上布滿細長、紫色的纖維狀條索，彼此交錯並纏住細胞與脂肪滴，這是檢體部分凝固產生的纖維蛋白絲（fibrin strands），屬於人為假象。
features: Long, thin, violet fibrillar strands crossing the field in parallel and arcing bundles
Strands entangling fat droplets, red cells, and smudged nucleated cells
Aggregated, distorted cells trapped at strand intersections
Few well-preserved hematopoietic cells available for evaluation
No cellular atypia assessable because of clot artifact
1115.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows abundant long, thin, violet fibrillar strands forming parallel bundles and arcs that entrap fat droplets, red cells, and distorted nucleated cells. Well-preserved hematopoietic cells are few, and cellular morphology is difficult to assess. These strands represent fibrin formed by partial clotting of the specimen before smearing. The finding is an artifact that may cause platelet and cell clumping and limit quantitative interpretation; a fresh anticoagulated sample is advisable if the smear is non-diagnostic.

ddx.dx: Stromal/reticulin fibers from a marrow particle
ddx.vs: Stromal elements appear within cohesive particles with associated stromal cells and capillaries, not as long cell-free strands across the smear.

ddx.dx: Mucin or amorphous extracellular material from metastatic tumor
ddx.vs: Mucin forms granular to bubbly lakes with atypical epithelial clusters rather than fine linear fibrils.
Serous atrophy material is amorphous pink-purple and granular rather than fibrillar.

1051.recognize_zh: 單顆大型淋巴球，細胞質豐富且呈深藍色、有少量空泡，核偏一側、染色質略開放，細胞被周圍紅血球擠壓變形，符合傳染性單核球增多症中細胞質強嗜鹼性的反應性淋巴球。
features: Large lymphocyte with low N:C ratio
Abundant intensely basophilic cytoplasm with a few small vacuoles
Eccentric oval nucleus with moderately condensed, slightly open chromatin
Cell outline molded by surrounding red cells
Unremarkable red cells and occasional platelets in the background
1051.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a large lymphocyte with abundant deeply basophilic, slightly vacuolated cytoplasm and an eccentric oval nucleus with moderately condensed chromatin. The cell border is indented by adjacent red cells. No nucleoli or cytoplasmic granules are identified. Findings are consistent with a reactive lymphocyte (immunoblastic/Downey type) as seen in infectious mononucleosis.

ddx.vs: Plasma cells have clock-face chromatin and a distinct perinuclear hof, and are rare in blood outside plasma cell leukemia.
Neoplastic cells show fine chromatin, nucleoli or irregular nuclear contours and a monotonous population, unlike this mature-appearing reactive cell.
Burkitt cells have deeply basophilic vacuolated cytoplasm but a high N:C ratio, multiple nucleoli and fine chromatin.

4187.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中成片的圓形細胞，細胞質豐富、嗜酸性，核圓至卵圓且位於中央、邊界清楚，為上皮樣排列的非典型肥大細胞浸潤線索；單憑 H&E 無法與漿細胞或其他細胞區分，需 tryptase、CD117、CD25 染色。
features: Sheet-like infiltrate of medium-sized round to polygonal cells
Moderate to abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm with distinct cell borders
Round to oval, centrally placed nuclei, some with small nucleoli
Interspersed small hyperchromatic cells and red cells
Adjacent bony trabecula and fat spaces
4187.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows a sheet-like infiltrate of medium-sized round to polygonal cells with moderate eosinophilic cytoplasm, distinct borders and round central nuclei, adjacent to a bony trabecula. Spindle-shaped mast cells and a perivascular or paratrabecular fibrotic pattern are not evident in this field, so the lineage cannot be established on H&E alone. Findings are compatible with a dense mast cell infiltrate in systemic mastocytosis, but confirmation with tryptase, CD117 and CD25 immunostains is required.

ddx.vs: Plasma cells have eccentric nuclei with clock-face chromatin and perinuclear hof and are CD138-positive rather than tryptase/CD117 positive.

ddx.dx: Erythroid hyperplasia or pure erythroid leukemia
ddx.vs: Erythroid precursors have round dark nuclei with scant cytoplasm in colonies and are E-cadherin/CD71 positive.
Carcinoma forms cohesive glands or nests and is keratin-positive.

3995.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中多個組織球的淡染、泡沫狀細胞質內，含有許多細小、均一的點狀小體（LD bodies），分布在細胞質內而非胞外；在 HIV 患者背景下提示內臟利什曼原蟲感染。
features: Numerous histiocytes with abundant pale, vacuolated cytoplasm
Tiny uniform dot-like intracytoplasmic bodies (about 2-3 um) within macrophages
Organism internal detail (kinetoplast) poorly resolved in tissue section
Scattered plasma cells, lymphocytes and hematopoietic cells
Suboptimal section quality with cracking artifact
3995.describe_en: Bone marrow biopsy section shows an infiltrate of histiocytes with abundant pale vacuolated cytoplasm containing numerous small, uniform dot-like intracellular organisms, admixed with plasma cells, lymphocytes and residual hematopoietic cells. The kinetoplast is not clearly resolved at this resolution in the section. In an HIV-infected patient, findings are consistent with Leishman-Donovan bodies of visceral leishmaniasis; confirmation by aspirate smear, Leishmania immunostain or PCR is recommended.

ddx.vs: Histoplasma yeasts are GMS/PAS positive with a halo and lack a kinetoplast, whereas Leishmania amastigotes are GMS negative.
MAC-laden histiocytes show striated foamy cytoplasm without discrete dots on H&E and are AFB positive.
Talaromyces yeasts divide by transverse septation and are GMS positive.

4059.recognize_zh: 藍色背景中，多顆梭形到卵圓形細胞的胞質顆粒呈紫紅色的變色反應（metachromasia），這是甲苯胺藍（toluidine blue）染色下肥大細胞的特徵；圖中另見黃綠色含鐵血黃素顆粒。
features: Numerous spindled to ovoid cells with metachromatic purple-magenta cytoplasmic granules
Granule intensity varies; some cells hypogranular with only faint purple staining
Oval bland nuclei; cells arranged in a loose streaming lesion
Scattered yellow-green refractile granules consistent with hemosiderin
Background orthochromatic blue-stained hematopoietic cells and fat spaces
4059.describe_en: Toluidine blue (or Giemsa-type) stain on a bone marrow biopsy highlights a loose lesion of spindled to ovoid cells containing metachromatic purple cytoplasmic granules, with variable degranulation or hypogranularity in a subset. Scattered yellow-green hemosiderin granules are present. The remaining hematopoietic cells stain orthochromatically blue. Findings are consistent with a mast cell infiltrate of systemic mastocytosis; because hypogranular neoplastic mast cells may be underestimated by metachromatic stains, tryptase and CD25 immunostains are preferred for quantification.

ddx.vs: Basophils are round with segmented nuclei and are 2D7/BB1-positive and CD25-negative, not spindled lesion-forming cells.
Reactive mast cells are round, scattered singly and well granulated rather than forming spindled aggregates.
Macrophage pigment is golden-green and refractile, not metachromatic purple, and stains blue with Prussian blue.

3931.recognize_zh: 三色染色（trichrome）下藍色的骨小樑增厚，骨小樑之間的骨髓空間被紡錘形細胞與藍色膠原纖維取代，造血細胞幾乎消失，代表膠原性纖維化（MF-3）合併骨硬化。
features: Thickened bony trabeculae staining blue
Intertrabecular space replaced by fibrous stroma with spindle cells
Blue-staining collagen fibers within the marrow space indicating collagen fibrosis
Dilated, thin-walled sinusoidal/vascular spaces
Near absence of normal hematopoietic cells
3931.describe_en: Masson trichrome stain of the bone marrow biopsy shows thickened bony trabeculae and an intertrabecular space replaced by a fibrovascular stroma of spindle cells and blue-staining collagen fibers. Dilated thin-walled vascular spaces are present, and normal hematopoietic cells are nearly absent. Findings indicate collagen fibrosis with osteosclerosis (MF-3), consistent with advanced primary myelofibrosis in the appropriate clinical and molecular context.

ddx.vs: Desmoplastic metastasis contains cohesive keratin-positive tumor cell nests within the collagen, which are not seen here.
Paget disease shows mosaic cement lines with prominent osteoclasts and osteoblasts and loose fibrovascular marrow, without MPN megakaryocytes or peripheral blood leukoerythroblastosis.
Therapy-related fibrosis follows a clinical history of treatment and lacks the clustered atypical megakaryocytes and driver mutations of PMF.

3867.recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓切片中，箭頭標示一片邊界不清、呈淡粉紅色的組織球聚集區，與周圍深染的造血細胞形成對比，是鬆散、未成熟的肉芽腫（poorly formed granuloma）。
features: Ill-defined pale eosinophilic nodular area (arrows) within cellular marrow
Loose aggregate of histiocytes with pale cytoplasm rather than a compact epithelioid granuloma
No well-formed multinucleated giant cells or caseous necrosis evident at this power
Surrounding hypercellular marrow with mixed hematopoietic cells
Bony trabeculae and adipocytes present
Organisms not resolvable at this low magnification
3867.describe_en: Low-power view of the bone marrow biopsy shows a hypercellular marrow containing an ill-defined, pale eosinophilic aggregate of histiocytes (arrows) that blends with the surrounding hematopoietic elements. The lesion lacks a sharp border, well-formed giant cells or caseous necrosis. Intracellular organisms cannot be assessed at this magnification. Findings are consistent with a poorly formed (loose) granuloma; in the clinical setting, GMS and PAS stains are recommended and are compatible with disseminated histoplasmosis.

ddx.vs: Tuberculous granulomas are more often compact with epithelioid cells, Langhans giant cells and caseous necrosis, and are identified with AFB stain.
Lipogranulomas are small aggregates of histiocytes around clear lipid vacuoles and are usually incidental.
Hodgkin lymphoma shows a fibrotic polymorphous infiltrate with Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells that are CD30 and CD15 positive.
Mast cell aggregates are composed of spindled cells with pale cytoplasm and eosinophils and are tryptase/CD117/CD25 positive.

3739.recognize_zh: 脾臟切片紅髓被一致的小型細胞瀰漫浸潤，核圓或腎形、周圍有透明細胞質（煎蛋樣，fried-egg），間隔整齊，並夾雜紅血球湖（blood lakes），是毛細胞白血病侵犯脾臟的典型表現。
features: Diffuse, monotonous infiltrate of small-to-medium cells occupying the red pulp
Round to oval or bean-shaped nuclei evenly spaced by clear to pale cytoplasm ('fried-egg' appearance)
Bland chromatin with inconspicuous nucleoli; mitoses not evident
Irregular pools of extravasated red cells forming blood lakes (pseudosinuses)
No white pulp nodules seen in this field
3739.describe_en: Section of spleen shows diffuse red pulp infiltration by a monotonous population of small-to-medium lymphoid cells with round to bean-shaped nuclei, bland chromatin and abundant clear cytoplasm that spaces the nuclei apart. Scattered red cell lakes lined by tumor cells are present. No white pulp nodules are identified in this field. Findings are consistent with splenic involvement by hairy cell leukemia; immunohistochemistry for CD20, annexin A1, TRAP/CD123 and BRAF V600E (VE1) is supportive.

ddx.vs: SMZL expands the white pulp with a biphasic nodular pattern rather than a diffuse red pulp infiltrate with blood lakes.

ddx.dx: Splenic diffuse red pulp small B-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: Also red pulp–predominant, but lacks the clear 'fried-egg' spacing and is annexin A1 and BRAF V600E negative.
HSTCL infiltrates sinusoids of red pulp with medium-sized cells that are CD3+ and CD20-.
Mast cell infiltrates are spindled with fibrosis and eosinophils and are tryptase/CD117 positive.

3803.recognize_zh: 低倍淋巴結切片中，大片淡粉紅、偏纖維化的細胞浸潤取代正常結構，只殘留少數深藍色淋巴濾泡，並可見淡染的結節狀區域，符合系統性肥大細胞症侵犯淋巴結；單顆肥大細胞在此倍率無法辨識。
features: Extensive effacement of lymph node architecture by a pale eosinophilic, fibrotic-appearing infiltrate
Only a few small residual lymphoid follicles (dark blue aggregates) remain
Vague pale nodules and sclerotic, perivascular-appearing zones within the infiltrate
Residual denser lymphoid tissue at the upper right edge
Individual mast cell cytology not resolvable at this magnification
3803.describe_en: Low-power section of lymph node shows extensive replacement of the nodal parenchyma by a pale, eosinophilic infiltrate with associated fibrosis and vague nodular pale areas. Only scattered small residual lymphoid follicles remain. Cellular detail cannot be assessed at this magnification. In context, findings are consistent with lymph node involvement by systemic mastocytosis; confirmation requires higher power and immunohistochemistry for tryptase, CD117 and CD25 and KIT D816V testing.

ddx.vs: NSCHL shows fibrous bands with Reed-Sternberg/lacunar cells that are CD30+/CD15+, not tryptase+/CD117+ spindle mast cells.
LCH involves sinuses with grooved Langerhans cells and eosinophils that are CD1a+/langerin+.

ddx.dx: Kimura disease or other eosinophil-rich reactive lymphadenopathy
ddx.vs: Reactive processes preserve follicles with eosinophilic microabscesses and lack aggregates of CD25+ mast cells.

3611.recognize_zh: 同一視野並列三種含顆粒的白血球：綠箭頭為細胞質豐富淡藍、帶少量嗜天青顆粒的大顆粒淋巴球（LGL）；紅箭頭為深紫黑粗顆粒遮蓋細胞核的嗜鹼性球；藍箭頭為分葉核、細小淡紫顆粒的嗜中性球。
features: Green arrow: large granular lymphocyte with round nucleus, abundant pale blue cytoplasm, and scattered fine azurophilic granules
Red arrow: basophil with coarse dark purple-black granules obscuring the nucleus
Blue arrow: segmented neutrophil with lobulated nucleus and fine lilac secondary granules
Background red cells normocytic with scattered normal platelets
3611.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows three granulated leukocytes for comparison. The cell marked by the green arrow is a large granular lymphocyte with a round nucleus and abundant pale blue cytoplasm containing a few fine azurophilic granules. The red arrow marks a basophil with coarse, dark purple-black granules obscuring the nuclear outline, and the blue arrow marks a segmented neutrophil with fine lilac granules. Red cells and platelets are unremarkable. This is a teaching comparison of normal granulated white cell types.

ddx.vs: Toxic granules are coarse and dark but remain in a neutrophil with visible lobated nucleus, unlike basophil granules that overlie the nucleus.
Mast cells are larger with a round central nucleus and densely packed uniform granules filling abundant cytoplasm.
Reactive lymphocytes have basophilic cytoplasm hugging red cells, usually without discrete azurophilic granules.
Eosinophil granules are larger, uniform, and orange-red refractile rather than purple-black or fine lilac.

3675.recognize_zh: 細胞量豐富的骨髓抹片中，大多數細胞是核呈腎形、帶狀或分葉、細胞質淡粉色帶顆粒的顆粒球系，核圓而濃縮、細胞質灰藍的紅血球母細胞只佔少數，因此 M:E 比明顯升高。
features: Cellular aspirate dominated by granulocytic precursors: myelocytes, metamyelocytes, bands and segmented neutrophils
Erythroid precursors with dense round nuclei are comparatively few, indicating an increased M:E ratio
Orderly granulocytic maturation with a full spectrum of stages
Occasional mitotic figure and scattered promyelocytes without an obvious blast excess
Fat vacuoles and interspersed red cells in the background
3675.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular field composed predominantly of granulocytic cells at all stages of maturation, with numerous myelocytes, metamyelocytes, bands and segmented neutrophils. Erythroid precursors are relatively sparse, yielding an increased myeloid-to-erythroid ratio. Maturation appears orderly, and blasts are not conspicuously increased in this field. Findings are consistent with an increased M:E ratio, which may reflect granulocytic hyperplasia (infection, inflammation, growth factor, CML) and/or erythroid hypoplasia, so correlation with the CBC, reticulocyte count and clinical history is needed.

ddx.vs: Shows granulocytic hyperplasia with a myelocyte peak, basophilia and dwarf megakaryocytes and requires BCR::ABL1 detection.

Increases the M:E ratio by near-absence of erythroid precursors with normal granulocytic cellularity, requiring reticulocyte count and cellularity assessment to separate from granulocytic hyperplasia.
Has ≥20% myeloblasts, often with Auer rods and dysplasia, unlike this predominantly maturing population.

3483.recognize_zh: 中高倍下一個濾泡內充滿單調的小型、核有角或裂痕的中心細胞（centrocytes），大型中心母細胞（centroblasts）很少，且看不到易染體巨噬細胞（tingible-body macrophages），周邊套區不明顯，支持低級別濾泡性淋巴瘤。
features: Neoplastic follicle composed of a monotonous population of small cells
Predominantly small cleaved/angulated nuclei (centrocytes) with condensed chromatin
Few scattered large centroblasts; centroblast count appears low (grade 1-2 range)
Absence of tingible-body macrophages and starry-sky pattern
Attenuated mantle zone at the follicle edge; small vessel at upper right
3483.describe_en: Higher-power view shows a neoplastic follicle filled by a monotonous population of small lymphoid cells with angulated and cleaved nuclei (centrocytes). Large centroblasts are infrequent, and tingible-body macrophages are not identified. The follicle lacks polarity and the surrounding mantle zone is thin and poorly defined. Findings are consistent with low-grade (grade 1-2 of 3) follicular lymphoma; formal grading requires counting centroblasts per high-power field.

ddx.vs: Reactive centers contain a mixed population of centrocytes and many centroblasts with frequent mitoses and tingible-body macrophages, forming a polarized structure.
Grade 3A shows more than 15 centroblasts per high-power field, whereas centroblasts are sparse in this follicle.
MCL cells are uniformly small-medium with irregular nuclei but lack admixed centroblasts and are cyclin D1 positive and CD10 negative.

3227.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中可見多個胞質豐富、淡染的組織球，胞質內吞入了完整的紅血球（橘紅色圓體）與小型有核細胞，這就是噬血現象（hemophagocytosis）。
features: Large histiocytes with abundant pale, finely vacuolated eosinophilic cytoplasm
Intact phagocytosed red cells (bright orange-red globules) within histiocyte cytoplasm
Engulfed small nucleated cells with dense round nuclei (erythroid precursors or lymphocytes) inside macrophages
Histiocyte nuclei small, oval, with fine chromatin, often displaced to the periphery
Background of hematopoietic cells including erythroid precursors and myeloid cells in a dilated sinusoidal stroma
3227.describe_en: Bone marrow biopsy section at high power shows scattered enlarged histiocytes with abundant pale cytoplasm. Several histiocytes contain intact erythrocytes and small nucleated cells with dense round nuclei within their cytoplasm. The histiocytes have bland oval nuclei without atypia. The surrounding marrow contains mixed hematopoietic precursors. Findings are consistent with hemophagocytosis, which in the clinical setting of acute EBV infection raises concern for hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis (HLH); correlation with clinical and laboratory HLH criteria is required.

ddx.vs: Erythroid precursors in an island surround the central macrophage rather than lying within intracytoplasmic phagocytic vacuoles.
Emperipolesis occurs within large lobulated megakaryocytes with intact passenger cells, whereas here the host cells are histiocytes with small oval nuclei.

ddx.dx: Hemophagocytic histiocytic neoplasm / T-cell lymphoma-associated HLH
ddx.vs: Secondary HLH to lymphoma shows an atypical lymphoid infiltrate on immunostains (e.g. CD3, CD30, EBER), which is not evident in this field.

3163.recognize_zh: 單一顆大型圓形母細胞，N:C比極高，染色質細緻略帶顆粒感，胞質僅剩一圈淡灰藍色，無顆粒也無Auer rod；形態本身不具特異性，要靠CD41/CD61證實為巨核母細胞。
features: Single large round blast, roughly twice the size of adjacent red cells
Very high N:C ratio with a thin rim of pale gray-blue agranular cytoplasm
Round nucleus with finely granular to slightly stippled chromatin
Nucleoli indistinct
No Auer rods, granules or distinct cytoplasmic blebs in this cell; background red cells with artifactual refractile inclusions
3163.describe_en: High-power smear shows a single large blast with a round nucleus, finely granular chromatin, indistinct nucleoli and a very scant rim of pale gray-blue agranular cytoplasm. No Auer rods or cytoplasmic granules are present. The morphology is that of an undifferentiated blast and is not by itself specific for megakaryocytic lineage. In the context of acute megakaryoblastic leukemia, lineage should be confirmed by flow cytometry or immunohistochemistry for CD41, CD61 and CD42b.

ddx.vs: Lymphoblasts may look identical and are separated by TdT, CD19/CD3 expression and absence of platelet glycoproteins CD41/CD61.
Myeloblasts may show fine azurophilic granules, Auer rods or MPO positivity, while megakaryoblasts are MPO negative and CD41/CD61 positive.

ddx.dx: Small round blue cell tumor (e.g. neuroblastoma, Ewing sarcoma)
ddx.vs: Metastatic tumor cells tend to form clumps and rosettes and lack CD45 and platelet glycoproteins.

3035.recognize_zh: 淋巴組織 H&E 高倍下可見多量大型免疫母細胞（immunoblasts），核仁明顯，並有一個雙核、類似 Reed-Sternberg 的細胞，背景混合小淋巴球、漿細胞與凋亡小體，呈多形性反應，符合傳染性單核球增多症。
features: Polymorphous lymphoid infiltrate of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid cells, and many large immunoblasts
Immunoblasts with vesicular nuclei, distinct nucleoli, and moderate amphophilic cytoplasm
Occasional binucleate or multinucleate Reed-Sternberg-like cells
Scattered apoptotic bodies and hyperchromatic pyknotic nuclei
Loss of normal architecture not assessable at this high magnification
3035.describe_en: Sections of lymphoid tissue show a polymorphous infiltrate composed of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid cells, and numerous large immunoblasts with vesicular chromatin, prominent nucleoli, and amphophilic cytoplasm. Binucleate and multinucleate Reed-Sternberg-like cells are present, along with scattered apoptotic bodies. The cellular spectrum is continuous from small to large cells rather than a monotonous population. In the appropriate clinical setting, findings are consistent with infectious mononucleosis (EBV lymphadenitis/tonsillitis); correlation with EBV serology and EBER in situ hybridization is recommended.

ddx.vs: HRS cells in cHL are CD30+/CD15+ with weak PAX5 and CD45-/CD20-, whereas IM immunoblasts are CD20+/CD45+ and usually CD15- within a continuous spectrum of activated cells.
DLBCL shows sheets of monotonous large cells effacing architecture, whereas IM shows a polymorphous mixture with preserved sinuses/follicles and polyclonal plasma cells.
ALCL has hallmark cells with horseshoe nuclei and strong uniform CD30 with T-cell markers, unlike the B-immunoblast rich polymorphous IM infiltrate.

2779.recognize_zh: 中倍下可見淋巴聚集內有淡粉紅、細胞較大的區域（中心母細胞與中心細胞組成的生發中心），外圈是深染的小淋巴球套區，旁邊可見紅血球系、顆粒球系與巨核細胞，符合骨髓反應性生發中心。
features: Lymphoid nodules with pale central zones of larger cells (centroblasts and centrocytes) with vesicular nuclei
Surrounding cuff of small, round, dark lymphocytes forming a mantle zone
Scattered histiocytes with pale eosinophilic cytoplasm within the germinal centers
Adjacent marrow shows maturing granulocytic and erythroid cells and a megakaryocyte
Sharp demarcation between follicle and surrounding hematopoiesis
2779.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at intermediate power shows lymphoid nodules with pale germinal centers composed of intermediate to large cells with vesicular nuclei and moderate eosinophilic cytoplasm, admixed with histiocytes. The germinal centers are surrounded by a mantle of small, dark, round lymphocytes. Adjacent hematopoietic marrow contains maturing myeloid and erythroid precursors and megakaryocytes. Findings are consistent with a reactive lymphoid follicle with germinal center in the bone marrow.

ddx.vs: Neoplastic follicles are paratrabecular, lack a distinct mantle and zonation, and show BCL2 expression in germinal center cells.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma involving marrow
ddx.vs: DLBCL forms sheets of large atypical cells that efface marrow without a mantle zone or mixed centrocyte/histiocyte population.
Granulomas consist of epithelioid histiocytes with elongated nuclei and may have giant cells, rather than a centroblast-centrocyte population ringed by small lymphocytes.

2715.recognize_zh: 中央一顆淋巴球，核濃縮、細胞質中等偏淡藍，細胞質周邊散布幾顆粗大的粉紫色顆粒；這種有顆粒的淋巴球即大顆粒淋巴球（LGL），是 NK 細胞增多的形態線索。
features: Medium-sized lymphocyte with moderate N:C ratio
Round nucleus with dense, clumped chromatin; nucleoli inconspicuous
Moderate pale blue cytoplasm
Discrete coarse azurophilic granules scattered at the cytoplasmic periphery
Normochromic red cells and scattered platelets; no blasts in field
2715.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows unremarkable normochromic red cells with scattered platelets. The field contains a medium-sized lymphocyte with mature, condensed chromatin and a moderate rim of pale cytoplasm containing a few coarse azurophilic granules. There are no blasts, nucleated red cells, or dysplastic features in this field. Findings are consistent with a large granular lymphocyte, supporting NK-cell lymphocytosis when an absolute LGL increase is documented; lineage and clonality require flow cytometry and molecular studies.

ddx.vs: Same LGL morphology; T-LGL is CD3+/CD8+/CD57+ with clonal TCR rearrangement, whereas NK cells are surface CD3-negative with CD16/CD56 expression.
Reactive lymphocytes show abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm hugging red cells and typically lack discrete azurophilic granules.
A neutrophil has a segmented nucleus and pink cytoplasm diffusely filled with granules rather than a round nucleus with a few discrete granules.

2587.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中一顆嗜中性球的細胞質布滿空泡，內含多顆被吞噬的深藍色圓形球菌，旁邊還有成串成簇的細胞外球菌，這種細胞內吞噬細菌是真性菌血症的證據，符合葡萄球菌敗血症。
features: Neutrophil with prominently vacuolated cytoplasm containing multiple phagocytosed round cocci
Clusters of uniform dark-blue cocci extracellularly adjacent to the neutrophil
Neutrophil nucleus appears condensed and eccentric
Small dark cell with pale cytoplasmic remnant at lower left (nucleated red cell or degenerating lymphocyte)
Thick area of smear with red cells in rouleaux-like aggregates
2587.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear, in a thick area with aggregated red cells, shows a neutrophil with extensive cytoplasmic vacuolization containing numerous phagocytosed round cocci, accompanied by small clusters of similar extracellular cocci. A small dark nucleated cell is present at the lower left. The presence of intracellular organisms within a vacuolated neutrophil indicates true circulating bacteria rather than contamination. Findings are consistent with overwhelming bacteremia with gram-positive cocci in clusters, supporting staphylococcal sepsis; blood cultures should be correlated.

ddx.vs: Toxic granules are fine dark-purple granules evenly distributed in non-vacuolated cytoplasm, not discrete uniform round cocci within vacuoles.
Histoplasma yeasts are larger oval forms with a clear halo and eccentric crescent of chromatin, rather than small solid round cocci.
Morulae are a single mulberry-like cluster of tiny basophilic inclusions within one cytoplasmic vacuole, without extracellular organisms.
Streptococci appear as pairs or chains, whereas the grape-like clustering here favors staphylococci; culture confirms species.

2523.recognize_zh: 箭頭指向一顆原始細胞在核與胞質交界處的細長粉紅色桿狀包涵體，即 Auer 小體（Auer rod），出現在骨髓性原始細胞中代表 AML。
features: Blast with a large round nucleus, fine chromatin and high N:C ratio
Moderate rim of agranular basophilic cytoplasm with a small cytoplasmic bleb
Thin, slender pink-red rod-shaped inclusion at the nuclear-cytoplasmic interface (arrow)
Single Auer rod; no bundles (faggots) seen
Background red cells show drying artifact; subtle inclusion is near the limit of image resolution
2523.describe_en: Smear at high power shows a blast with a large round nucleus, finely dispersed chromatin and a moderate rim of agranular basophilic cytoplasm. A single slender pink-red rod-shaped inclusion, indicated by the arrow, lies at the nuclear-cytoplasmic interface, consistent with an Auer rod. No multiple Auer rods (faggot cells) are seen. The presence of Auer rods establishes myeloid lineage of the blast and is consistent with acute myeloid leukemia; if blasts are below 20%, Auer rods still indicate at least MDS with excess blasts.

ddx.vs: APL cells contain bundles of multiple Auer rods and heavy azurophilic granules with bilobed nuclei, unlike this single rod in an agranular blast.

ddx.dx: Azurophilic granules in a lymphoblast or large granular lymphocyte
ddx.vs: Azurophilic granules are round dots rather than elongated rods and do not stain as needle-like MPO-positive inclusions.

ddx.dx: Platelet or stain precipitate overlying a cell
ddx.vs: Overlying debris lies in a different plane and is not a sharply linear rod within the cytoplasm.

2395.recognize_zh: 中央一顆巨大的巨核細胞，核分成多個彼此分離的圓形核葉（類似撞球散開），周圍是密集的顆粒球前驅細胞與含粗顆粒的嗜鹼性球；在 CML 中出現這種核分離的異常巨核細胞與嗜鹼性球增多，要考慮疾病進展到加速期。
features: Very large megakaryocyte with multiple widely separated, round nuclear lobes (dysplastic, pawn-ball-like)
Abundant finely granular pale lilac cytoplasm with a defined border
Hypercellular background of granulocytic precursors at all stages of maturation
Scattered basophils/basophil precursors with coarse dark granules (lower right)
Few erythroid precursors in the field
2395.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a markedly hypercellular granulocytic background with all stages of maturation and scattered basophil-lineage cells containing coarse dark granules. Centrally there is a very large megakaryocyte with multiple separated round nuclear lobes and abundant finely granular cytoplasm, a dysplastic form. Blasts are not clearly increased in this field. In the setting of BCR::ABL1-positive CML, dysplastic megakaryocytes accompanied by basophilia may be seen with disease progression; findings are compatible with accelerated phase features, pending blast and basophil counts and cytogenetic studies.

ddx.vs: MDS shows dysplastic megakaryocytes in a usually normo- or hypocellular marrow with dysgranulopoiesis and without basophilia or BCR::ABL1.
Megaloblastic anemia and therapy effect can produce hyperlobated megakaryocytes but with megaloblastic erythroids and giant bands rather than a granulocytic proliferation with basophils.
Chronic phase megakaryocytes are typically small and hypolobated (dwarf megakaryocytes); separated multinucleated forms and increasing basophils/blasts suggest progression.

2203.recognize_zh: 油鏡下單一芽細胞，核佔大部分細胞、染色質細緻均勻、核仁淡，只有一圈深藍無顆粒細胞質；箭頭指向細胞表面的小突起（cytoplasmic blebs），形態屬淋巴芽細胞，Ph+ 無法由外觀判定。
features: Single blast about 1.5–2 times RBC diameter with very high N:C ratio
Round nucleus with finely stippled, evenly dispersed chromatin
Faint, inconspicuous nucleoli
Thin rim of deeply basophilic agranular cytoplasm
Small surface cytoplasmic projections/blebs (arrow)
